_comment: Manual CNMFe parameter overrides, applied by agent/params.py:estimate_all_params after the Cn/PNR estimate and after animal_params.json. Animal-level keys apply to every session of that animal; a 'sessions' block keyed by session folder name applies to one session and wins. Keys: min_corr, min_pnr, gSig, gSiz, bd. Keys starting with '_' are comments. This file is never rewritten by the pipeline (animal_params.json is rebuilt by extract_params.m after every completed session).
_decision_2026-10-05: User: min_corr 0.70 for the cohort-5 retro-tdTomato vCA1 animals (the per-session 85th-percentile estimate gave 0.78-0.85; measured reasoning in agent/eval/cohort5_2026-09/LOG.md). Provisional vCA1 default from now on: add new vCA1 animals here at 0.70 until the 12 re-run pilot sessions come back and the value is reassessed. min_pnr stays estimated (not the binding gate).
_decision_2026-10-18: Session-level 0.60 for 082726-pnb105 only (user decision 2026-10-18); superseded 2026-10-28 by the animal-level 0.60 below.
_decision_2026-10-28: User: min_corr 0.60 for every pnb105 session (its fields are uniformly weak: 082726 gave 79 candidates at 0.70, 090526 FOVC gave 44; LOG.md 2026-10-28 10:15). The other five cohort-5 animals stay at 0.70. 090526-pnb105 is re-run at 0.60; the already reviewed 082626-pnb105 (0.70, 266 candidates) is not re-run.
_decision_2026-11-02: User: re-run 090526-pnb99 (FOVB, single-day field, 30 candidates at 0.70; 2.8% of pixels at Cn >= 0.70 vs 19-23% on the FOVA days) at min_corr 0.60 and push it again. Session-level only: the other pnb99 sessions are FOVA and stay at 0.70 (LOG.md 2026-11-02).
_decision_2026-11-20: User, after 19 of the 28 cohort-5 6odor sessions came back labelled (LOG.md 2026-11-20): 0.70 for bright sessions, 0.60 for dim ones, set per session by hand, no automatic detector. (1) pnb105 goes back to the animal-level 0.70: on its bright field the 0.60 seed found about 2 extra cells in 4 sessions for 1.3 duplicate candidates per kept cell. Its nine 6odor sessions already run and reviewed (082726 and the six 09xx at 0.60, 082626 at 0.70) are NOT re-run; this value applies to sessions processed from now on. (2) The 11 3odor sessions whose 50th-strongest Cn peak (pk50, full-movie seeding image, agent/eval/3odor_intake_2026-11/redteam/c6_sessions.tsv) is below 0.70 get a session-level 0.60. The two pnb109 entries are low on pk50 because few cells are visible (damaged lens), not because the image is noisy. An entry is inert until that session is staged; which 3odor sessions are run at all is still open (docs/HANDOFF_2026-11-20_3ODOR_STAGING.md). min_pnr stays estimated (+2 was considered and dropped).
_decision_2026-11-21: User, labelled dim run (docs/HANDOFF_2026-11-20_3ODOR_STAGING.md section 5): 092926-pnb99-518um (FOVA), 092926-pnb102-460um (FOVA) and 100126-pnb99-493um (FOVC) are run ONCE at session-level 0.575 (full-movie noise floor 0.55 + 0.025) and reviewed at threshold 0, so one review shows what 0.60, 0.65 and 0.70 would each have kept. Before this entry 092926-pnb99 resolved to the animal-level 0.70 and the other two to 0.60. Also decided: 092926-pnb105-430um, 092926-pnb109-133um and 093026-pnb109-90um are NOT run (their behavioural day was redone after the lens cleaning as 100226-pnb105, 100126-pnb109 and 100226-pnb109); their 0.60 entries below are left in place and stay inert. The remaining dim sessions keep 0.60 and are reviewed at threshold 0.
